name: ASIMO
dof_breakdown: figure for the final 2011 model; earlier versions had 26–34
summary: Honda's long-running showcase humanoid and, for over a decade, the public face of the field. Successive versions walked, climbed stairs, ran at up to 9 km/h, hopped on one leg, poured drinks and recognized faces and gestures. It was never sold; Honda ended ASIMO development in 2018 and retired its demonstrations in 2022, redirecting the work toward more practical machines.
